mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate directly lowers equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days without threshold requirements.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% for two consecutive months signals labor market deterioration, triggering immediate equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >50% of triggered instances, or signal Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate housing market collapse, amplifying equity risk and driving negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Joint decline in RSAFS/HOUST fails to predict negative returns in >55% of cases, or interaction term p-value > 0.05 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100 indicates supply chain disruption, causing inflationary pressures that suppress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are positive in >55% of INDPRO < 100 periods, or signal Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Rising GDP growth (GDPC1) consistently signals expanding economic activity, increasing corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative in >55% of GDPC1 growth periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% YoY for three months triggers central bank tightening expectations, depressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are positive in >50% of triggered instances, or signal Rank IC < 0.02 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in unemployment (UNRATE) and declines in payrolls (PAYEMS) signal severe labor market contraction, amplifying recession fears and driving negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: Joint UNRATE rise/PAYEMS decline fails to predict negative returns in >55% of cases, or interaction term p-value > 0.05 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.0% signals active monetary tightening, increasing cost of capital and suppressing equity valuations to produce negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive in >55% of FEDFUNDS > 4.0% periods, or signal Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.
